name: Sample frontend honesty and partial-source regressions
status: Frozen expected-output vectors for later runnable tests

review.implementation_tests: Not run; no implementation or test runner exists
review.basis: Self-contained fictional source snapshots checked directly against each expected output. These snapshots are not extracted real documents and do not satisfy the real-input integration requirement.

fixtures.sample_label: Sample demo: fictional sources for illustration.
fixtures.question: What should I verify before applying for the Nova Merit Scholarship?

sources.title: Fictional Nova Merit Scholarship guidelines
sources.trust_origin: Fictional sample metadata; not an authenticated organization

blocks.text: Applicants must be aged 17-25 and be Indian citizens.
Family income must be below INR 6,00,000. Submit an income certificate issued within the last 6 months.
The scholarship amount is INR 50,000 per year.

unread_content.description: Decorative banner not analyzed as text

blocks.text: Applicants must be aged 17-25 and be Indian citizens.
Income proof: Form 16 or ITR of parents.
Applications close at the end of November.
For the 2025 application cycle, the deadline was 30 November 2025.
The amount is INR 50,000. Apply through the portal.

cases.title: Unprepared question must not become a false absence claim

input.sources: All three fixture sources are readable

expected_output.reply_text: This sample demo has no prepared answer to that question

cases.verification_notes: The guidelines and listing eligibility blocks both explicitly contain 17-25. Lack of a prepared reply therefore cannot justify saying the age limit was not found.

cases.title: Checked missing renewal topic may use scoped not-found wording

input.sources: All three fixture sources are readable

expected_output.scope_text: Not found in the text of 3 sources reviewed
expected_output.next_check_suggestion: Check the latest official renewal policy

cases.verification_notes: Every fixture text block was checked; none describes renewal conditions. The unprocessed banner cannot be treated as reviewed evidence, so the absence claim is expressly limited to text.

cases.title: Zero readable sources produces failure rather than empty-corpus findings
cases.verification_notes: Three inputs satisfy initial source-count validation, but none is readable after the simulated failures. No corpus was reviewed, and the normal three-source fixture totals cannot survive this failure state.

cases.title: One readable source suppresses cross-source findings and comparisons

input.question: Use the fixture research question
input.demo_state: Explicitly labelled simulated partial source-reading failure

expected_output.supported_single_source_observation_may_: Family income must be below INR 6,00,000.
expected_output.any_gap_scope: The text of the one reviewed source

cases.verification_notes: Only the guidelines remain readable. The income ceiling appears verbatim there. Both candidate cross-source findings depend on the failed listing and must be suppressed, even though its fixture text is still known to the test author.

cases.title: Structured summary exposes cited facts and qualified differences

input.sources: All three fixture sources are readable
input.action: Open the completed sample Overview, then activate each summary citation

citation_navigation.quote: Applicants must be aged 17-25 and be Indian citizens.
Submit an income certificate issued within the last 6 months.
Income proof: Form 16 or ITR of parents.
The scholarship amount is INR 50,000 per year.

expected_output.document_difference_uncertainty: Possible conflict; confirm the current official document list

cases.verification_notes: Each expected quote was compared character-for-character with its named source block. The two document requirements differ, but those textual differences do not establish a definitive contradiction or which requirement is current. Citation activation must preserve source ID and revision rather than finding a similar phrase elsewhere.
